FE Invisible GUI Hypol-X Alpha | Roblox Invisible Script [Keyless]

This script includes an Invisible GUI that lets you toggle invisibility ON/OFF, with a clean, draggable interface!

Features:

Invisible Mode — Toggle invisibility on or off through the GUI or by pressing G. Your character becomes partially transparent, with additional positioning behavior designed to make you harder to see..
No-Collide Feature — Disables local collision for other characters while invisibility is enabled.
Modern GUI — Clean design with smooth animations, toggle effects, and notifications.
Minimize & Restore — Minimize the GUI into a floating sphere and tap it to restore the main panel.
Draggable Interface — Move the main GUI and minimized sphere wherever you want.
Close Confirmation — Confirm before closing the GUI.
Respawn Handling — Resets the invisibility state when your character respawns.

What Does Alpha Mean?

Alpha means this script is an early development version. It may still have bugs, incomplete features, or unexpected behavior. More improvements, fixes, and changes may come in future updates.

How to Use:

1. Execute the script.
2. Press the toggle in the GUI or press G to activate/deactivate invisibility.
3. Stand up before enabling invisibility if your character is seated.
4. Minimize the GUI whenever you want a smaller interface.

Notice this script still Alpha A few Bugs may unexpectedly Appear.

- Hypol-X Made

scripts.features: Auto Click the starter dropper, auto collect your tycoon money, simple vibecoded script to make the tycoon experience more efficient.
scripts.script:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

if _G.AutoClickerRunId then
	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1
else
	_G.AutoClickerRunId = 1
end
local myRun = _G.AutoClickerRunId

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("AutoClickerGUI")
if old then
	old:Destroy()
end

local function tycoonNameOfClicker(clicker: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return clicker.Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function tycoonNameOfGiver(giver: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return giver.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function collectClickers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Clicker" then
			local model = d.Parent.Parent
			local mine = model and model.Parent
			if model and model.Name == "Model" and mine then
				table.insert(found, {
					clicker = d.Parent,
					detector = d,
					model = model,
					mine = mine,
					tycoon = tycoonNameOfClicker(d.Parent),
				})
				if #found >= 50 then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function collectGivers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "Giver" and d:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
			table.insert(found, {
				part = d,
				tycoon = tycoonNameOfGiver(d),
			})
			if #found >= 50 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local entries = collectClickers()
local givers = collectGivers()

local KEYWORDS = { "click", "mine", "drop", "upgrade", "tycoon", "speed", "button", "ore" }

local function nameMatches(n: string): boolean
	local l = string.lower(n)
	for _, k in ipairs(KEYWORDS) do
		if string.find(l, k, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local allRemotes: any = {}
local seen: any = {}
local function addRemote(r: any)
	if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") and not seen[r] then
		seen[r] = true
		table.insert(allRemotes, r)
	end
end

local function scanRoot(root: any, cap: number, onlyMatching: boolean)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return root:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		n += 1
		if n > cap then
			break
		end
		if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			if not onlyMatching or nameMatches(d.Name) then
				addRemote(d)
			end
			if #allRemotes >= 25 then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
	scanRoot(e.clicker, 50, false)
	scanRoot(e.model, 100, false)
	scanRoot(e.mine, 200, false)
end
scanRoot(ReplicatedStorage, 2000, true)

local hasFireClick = (typeof(fireclickdetector) == "function")
local hasFireTouch = (typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function")

local clickNames: any = {}
for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
	table.insert(clickNames, e.tycoon)
end
print("[AutoClicker] Click tycoons (" .. tostring(#entries) .. "): " .. table.concat(clickNames, ", "))
local giverNames: any = {}
for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
	table.insert(giverNames, g.tycoon .. "=" .. g.part:GetFullName())
end
print("[AutoClicker] Money givers (" .. tostring(#givers) .. "): " .. table.concat(giverNames, " | "))
if #entries == 0 then
	warn("[AutoClicker] No ClickDetectors found under workspace.Tycoons.")
end
if #givers == 0 then
	warn("[AutoClicker] No Giver+Attachment parts found under workspace.Tycoons.")
end
if not hasFireClick then
	warn("[AutoClicker] fireclickdetector() missing in Studio. Remote fallback will be used.")
end
if not hasFireTouch then
	warn("[AutoClicker] firetouchinterest() missing in Studio. Collect falls back to teleporting your character.")
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AutoClickerGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 196)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.3, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local dragBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
dragBar.Name = "DragBar"
dragBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
dragBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
dragBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
dragBar.Text = "DRAG HERE"
dragBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
dragBar.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
dragBar.TextSize = 13
dragBar.Active = true
dragBar.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggleBtn.TextSize = 16
toggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
toggleBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

local collectBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
collectBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
collectBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 80)
collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
collectBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
collectBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
collectBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
collectBtn.TextSize = 16
collectBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
collectBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local collectCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
collectCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
collectCorner.Parent = collectBtn

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 18
closeBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 62)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 128)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
statusLabel.TextSize = 12
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
statusLabel.TextWrapped = true
statusLabel.Text = "starting..."
statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local enabled = false
local collectEnabled = false
local dragging = false
local dragStart = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local startPos = mainFrame.Position
local fires = 0
local collects = 0
local connections = {}

local function refreshStatus()
	local methodText = "NONE"
	if hasFireClick and #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = "fireclick+" .. tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	elseif hasFireClick then
		methodText = "fireclick"
	elseif #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	end
	local touchText = if hasFireTouch then "invisible" else "teleport"
	statusLabel.Text = "Clickers: " .. tostring(#entries) .. " | " .. methodText .. "\nMoneyGivers: " .. tostring(#givers) .. " (" .. touchText .. ") | Fires: " .. tostring(fires) .. " | Collects: " .. tostring(collects)
end
refreshStatus()

local function cleanup()
	enabled = false
	collectEnabled = false
	dragging = false
	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	screenGui:Destroy()
	collectgarbage("collect")
end

table.insert(connections, dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled
	if enabled then
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: ON"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 85)
	else
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: OFF"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, collectBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	collectEnabled = not collectEnabled
	if collectEnabled then
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: ON"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 200)
	else
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, closeBtn.Activated:Connect(cleanup))

local function doCollectAll()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	if hasFireTouch then
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 0)
				task.wait()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 1)
			end)
		end
	else
		local saved: CFrame = hrp.CFrame
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				hrp.CFrame = g.part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end)
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		pcall(function()
			hrp.CFrame = saved
		end)
	end
	collects += 1
	refreshStatus()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
		if collectEnabled and #givers > 0 then
			pcall(doCollectAll)
		end
		local waited = 0
		while waited < 5 and myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
			task.wait(0.1)
			waited += 0.1
		end
	end
end)

local hbConn
hbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId then
		pcall(function()
			hbConn:Disconnect()
		end)
		return
	end
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	fires += 1
	if hasFireClick then
		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			pcall(fireclickdetector, e.detector)
		end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(allRemotes) do
		pcall(function()
			r:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	if fires % 15 == 0 then
		refreshStatus()
	end
end)
table.insert(connections, hbConn)

-- UTILS
local function waitForAnimate(char)
	for _ = 1, 40 do
		local a = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		if a and a:FindFirstChild("idle") and a:FindFirstChild("run") and a:FindFirstChild("walk") then
			return a
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return nil
end

local function setAnim(animObj, id)
	if animObj and id then
		animObj.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
	end
end

local function stopAllTracks(hum)
	if not hum then return end
	for _, t in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end)
	end
end

local function ensureAnim(folder, name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local a = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not a then
		a = Instance.new("Animation")
		a.Name = name
		a.Parent = folder
	end
	return a
end

local function ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, n)
	if not idleFolder then return end
	n = n or 2
	for i=1,n do
		ensureAnim(idleFolder, "Animation" .. i)
	end
end

local function pick(pack, ...)
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local k = select(i, ...)
		local v = pack[k]
		if v ~= nil then return v end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Altın Parlama Efekti Fonksiyonu
local function applyGoldGlowEffect(textLabel)
	textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0) -- Altın Sarısı
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Transparency = 0.2
	stroke.Parent = textLabel

	-- Parlama Döngüsü (Pulsing Glow)
	spawn(function()
		while textLabel and textLabel.Parent do
			local tween1 = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Transparency = 0.6, Thickness = 1})
			tween1:Play()
			tween1.Completed:Wait()
			local tween2 = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Transparency = 0.1, Thickness = 2.5})
			tween2:Play()
			tween2.Completed:Wait()
		end
	end)
end

-- APPLY PACK
local ATTR_LAST = "AnimPack_Last"
local applying = false

local function applyPack(packName)
	if applying then return false end
	applying = true

	local pack = PACKS[packName]
	if not pack then
		warn("Unknown pack:", packName)
		applying = false
		return false
	end

	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local animate = waitForAnimate(char)
	if not animate then
		warn("Animate not found")
		applying = false
		return false
	end

	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	stopAllTracks(hum)

	local runObj   = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("run"),   "RunAnim")
	local walkObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("walk"),  "WalkAnim")
	local jumpObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("jump"),  "JumpAnim")
	local fallObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("fall"),  "FallAnim")
	local climbObj = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("climb"), "ClimbAnim")
	local swimObj  = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("swim"),     "Swim")
	local swimIdleObj = ensureAnim(animate:FindFirstChild("swimidle"), "SwimIdle")
	local idleFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("idle")

	setAnim(walkObj,  pick(pack, "WalkAnim", "Walk"))
	setAnim(runObj,   pick(pack, "RunAnim", "Run"))
	setAnim(jumpObj,  pick(pack, "JumpAnim", "Jump"))
	setAnim(fallObj,  pick(pack, "FallAnim", "Fall"))
	setAnim(climbObj, pick(pack, "ClimbAnim", "Climb"))

	setAnim(swimObj,      pick(pack, "Swim"))
	setAnim(swimIdleObj,  pick(pack, "SwimIdle") or pick(pack, "Swim"))

	if idleFolder then
		local a1 = pick(pack, "Animation1")
		local a2 = pick(pack, "Animation2")

		if a1 or a2 then
			ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, 2)
			local id1 = a1 or a2
			local id2 = a2 or a1 or id1
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), id1)
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), id2)
		elseif pack.Idle and #pack.Idle > 0 then
			ensureIdleSlots(idleFolder, math.max(2, #pack.Idle))
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), pack.Idle[1])
			setAnim(idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), pack.Idle[2] or pack.Idle[1])
			for i = 3, #pack.Idle do
				local a = idleFolder:FindFirstChild("Animation" .. i)
				if a then setAnim(a, pack.Idle[i]) end
			end
		end
	end

	animate.Disabled = true
	task.wait(0.06)
	animate.Disabled = false

	if hum then
		pcall(function()
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
			task.wait(0.03)
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
		end)
	end

	pcall(function() player:SetAttribute(ATTR_LAST, packName) end)

	applying = false
	return true
end

-- Helper Function to Create Buttons/Switches
local function createButton(name, text)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = name
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 35)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#333333")
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#FFFFFF")
	btn.Text = text
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	btn.TextSize = 14
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	btn.Parent = ScrollContainer
	return btn
end

-- Helper Function to Create Input Boxes
local function createTextBox(name, placeholder)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.Name = name
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 35)
	box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#2A2A2A")
	box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#FFFFFF")
	box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
	box.Text = ""
	box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	box.TextSize = 14
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", box)
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	box.Parent = ScrollContainer
	return box
end

-- UI Components Creation
local LeaveBtn = createButton("LeaveButton", "Leave Game")
local RejoinBtn = createButton("RejoinButton", "Rejoin Server")

local SpinSwitch = createButton("SpinSwitch", "Spin: OFF")
local NoclipSwitch = createButton("NoclipSwitch", "Noclip: OFF")
local FlySwitch = createButton("FlySwitch", "Fly: OFF")
local FlingSwitch = createButton("FlingSwitch", "Touch Fling: OFF")
local JumpBox = createTextBox("JumpBox", "Enter Jump Power")
local SpeedBox = createTextBox("SpeedBox", "Enter Speed")
local SelfDestructBtn = createButton("SelfDestructBtn", "Self-Destruct Yourself")
SelfDestructBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#E8BEAC")
SelfDestructBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#000000")

-- Main Toggle Panel Logic
MainButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	PanelFrame.Visible = not PanelFrame.Visible
end)

-- Leave / Rejoin Logic
LeaveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	LocalPlayer:Kick("Manually Left via Player Panel")
end)

RejoinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
end)

-- Speed & Jump Logic
SpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
	if enterPressed then
		local val = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text)
		if val and Humanoid then
			Humanoid.WalkSpeed = val
		end
	end
end)

JumpBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
	if enterPressed then
		local val = tonumber(JumpBox.Text)
		if val and Humanoid then
			Humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
			Humanoid.JumpPower = val
		end
	end
end)

-- Noclip Logic
NoclipSwitch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isNoclipOn = not isNoclipOn
	NoclipSwitch.Text = "Noclip: " .. (isNoclipOn and "ON" or "OFF")
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if isNoclipOn and Character then
		for _, part in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Anchor Logic
AnchorSwitch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isAnchorOn = not isAnchorOn
	AnchorSwitch.Text = "Anchor: " .. (isAnchorOn and "ON" or "OFF")
	if HumanoidRootPart then
		HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = isAnchorOn
	end
end)

-- Touch Fling Logic
FlingSwitch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isTouchFlingOn = not isTouchFlingOn
	FlingSwitch.Text = "Touch Fling: " .. (isTouchFlingOn and "ON" or "OFF")
	
	task.spawn(function()
		while isTouchFlingOn and Character and HumanoidRootPart do
			local vel = HumanoidRootPart.Velocity
			HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
			task.wait(0.2)
			if HumanoidRootPart then
				HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = vel
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end)
end)

-- Self-Destruct Sequence Logic
SelfDestructBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	-- Flashing color routine
	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 8 do
			SelfDestructBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#FF0000")
			task.wait(0.5)
